title: Automorphism
description: JSON Schema for an automorphism — a morphism f : A → A that is both an endomorphism (domain equals codomain) and an isomorphism (has a two-sided inverse) (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. I §5). Automorphisms at a single object form the automorphism group Aut(A) under composition. Specializes via a two-element allOf naming both parent shapes: endomorphism and isomorphism.
